purpose:
[OPTIMIZED] Extracts isolation metrics, clusters, and leaks for a specific architectural layer.
Use this before refactoring a large component to understand its internal cohesion.
parameters: layer_name (string, required): target architectural layer name or path selector (accepts dotted layer names and nested layer paths).
max_clusters (integer or null, default 8): maximum number of cluster entries to return; pass null for unlimited clusters.
max_boundary_violations (integer or null, default 10): maximum number of boundary violations to return; pass null for unlimited violations.
compact (boolean, default true): when true, returns up to 3 bounded evidence items per non-empty collection with total, truncated, and expand metadata; set to false for full items.
fields (array of strings or null, default null): optional projection list of top-level keys to return; null returns the full response.
behavior:
1. Uses a dedicated layer report when present and otherwise derives bounded boundary evidence from canonical LIVE state.
2. Clusters and boundary violations are independently bounded by max_clusters and max_boundary_violations.
3. Collections always expose total and truncated metadata with expand instructions.
4. Preserves full requested layer identity without imposing artificial hierarchy changes.
usage_notes:
LLM use: call before moving modules or changing layer boundaries. Resolve a
truncated tail only when the planned edit touches that omitted evidence.
